correctness.rationale: Direct disk inequality yields rank-order cosine cutoffs. The exact radial polygon boundary dominates the second cutoff by cosine product-to-sum for all n>=3; hence every higher-order overlap area is an untruncated polar integral with explicit positivity limits. Integration yields the stated tail formula. The exceptional n=3 case and all n<=30 were separately checked by direct unsorted-disk quadrature; numerical checks are only supplementary.
